menuCategories.name: Cookies
menuCategories.note: Large bakery-style cookies. Seasonal availability may vary.

items.name: COCO’s Double Chocolate Cookies & Cream
items.description: Dark cocoa and fine Oreo cookie powder create a deep cookies-and-cream base, finished with Oreo pieces, creamy white chocolate and melted semi-sweet chocolate.
items.texture: Thick and fudgy with a brownie-like center and crisp cookie pieces.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: TOFFEE’s Brown Butter Espresso Crunch
items.description: Nutty brown butter and espresso meet semi-sweet and milk chocolate, with generous pieces of homemade crunchy caramelized toffee.
items.texture: Thick and chewy with melted chocolate and crisp toffee throughout.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and soy. Contains caffeine. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookie
items.description: A buttery, vanilla-forward cookie loaded with semi-sweet and milk chocolate for a rich chocolate flavor without excessive sweetness.
items.texture: Thick and chewy with golden edges, a soft center and pools of melted chocolate.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Seasonal Cranberry White Chocolate Oatmeal Cookie
items.description: Old-fashioned oats, tart dried cranberries and white chocolate are brightened with fresh orange zest and warm cinnamon.
items.texture: Thick and chewy with crisp edges, a soft center and a hearty oat crumb.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, soy and oats. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: White Chocolate Macadamia Cookie
items.description: Creamy white chocolate and roasted macadamia pieces fill a rich vanilla cookie designed for a premium bakery-style bite.
items.texture: Thick and chunky with a soft center, crisp golden edges and crunchy roasted nuts.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, soy and tree nuts (macadamia). Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and other tree nuts.

items.name: S’mores Cookie
items.description: Graham-flavored cookie dough surrounds a gooey marshmallow center with milk and semi-sweet chocolate, visible graham pieces and a toasted graham base.
items.texture: Thick and soft-centered with gooey marshmallow, melted chocolate and crisp graham accents.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Peanut Butter Blossom Cookie
items.description: A peanut-butter-forward cookie with a light sugar coating and one decorative molded chocolate centerpiece.
items.texture: Thick, soft and chewy with a lightly crackled exterior.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, peanuts and soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles tree nuts.

menuCategories.name: Brownies & Blondies
menuCategories.note: Available as large bakery squares or smaller portions.

items.name: Classic Fudge Brownie
items.description: Dark chocolate, Dutch-process cocoa, a touch of coffee and semi-sweet chocolate chips create a deeply chocolate brownie.
items.texture: Dense and fudgy with chewy edges and a shiny top.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and soy. Contains caffeine. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Funfetti Blondie
items.description: A vanilla birthday-cake blondie built on white chocolate, filled with white chocolate chips and bright rainbow sprinkles.
items.texture: Thick, chewy, buttery and soft with a rich white-chocolate crumb.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

menuCategories.name: Muffins & Cinnamon Rolls
menuCategories.note: Jumbo bakery muffins and large individual cinnamon rolls.

items.name: Chocolate Chip Jumbo Muffin
items.description: A large bakery-style vanilla muffin with chocolate throughout and a tall golden dome.
items.texture: Moist and buttery with a tender crumb and melted chocolate chips.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Blueberry Jumbo Muffin
items.description: Fresh blueberries fill a lightly lemon-scented vanilla muffin finished with a sparkling coarse-sugar top.
items.texture: Tall and tender with distinct berries, a moist crumb and a lightly crunchy top.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Coffee Cake Jumbo Muffin
items.description: A sour-cream muffin layered with a cinnamon ribbon and topped generously with buttery bakery-style streusel.
items.texture: Moist and tender with a substantial crunchy crumb topping.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Jumbo Individual Cinnamon Roll with Vanilla Icing
items.description: A large individual roll with a defined cinnamon-brown-sugar spiral and a generous layer of smooth vanilla butter icing.
items.texture: Tall, soft and fluffy with a moist, gooey center and lightly caramelized edges.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

menuCategories.name: Savory Baking
menuCategories.note: Individual savory pastries are available by custom order.

items.name: Bacon, Gruyère & Caramelized Onion Quiche
items.description: A French-style individual quiche with smoky bacon, sweet caramelized onion, Gruyère and a silky seasoned custard.
items.texture: Thin crisp buttery pastry with a creamy custard that holds a clean shape.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

menuCategories.name: Tartlets
menuCategories.note: Available as an assorted selection or by flavor.

items.name: Assorted Individual Tartlets
items.description: An assortment of vanilla custard and fresh berry, lemon cream with vanilla cream, and chocolate hazelnut tartlets in crisp almond pâte sucrée shells.
items.texture: Thin crisp shells with silky fillings and distinct fruit, citrus and chocolate finishes.
items.allergens: The assortment contains wheat, milk, egg, soy and tree nuts (almond and hazelnut). Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts.

items.name: Vanilla Custard & Fresh Berry Tartlet
items.description: A crisp almond pâte sucrée shell filled with silky vanilla custard, generously topped with fresh berries and finished with a light glaze.
items.texture: Crisp pastry, smooth custard and fresh juicy berries.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and tree nuts (almond). Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, other tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Lemon Cream Tartlet with Vanilla Cream
items.description: A crisp almond pâte sucrée shell filled with bright lemon cream and finished with a neat ring of stabilized vanilla mascarpone cream.
items.texture: Crisp pastry with silky lemon filling and light, creamy vanilla accents.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg and tree nuts (almond). Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, other tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Chocolate Hazelnut Tartlet
items.description: A crisp almond pâte sucrée shell with silky dark chocolate ganache, light hazelnut whipped ganache and toasted hazelnuts.
items.texture: Crisp pastry with smooth rich chocolate and airy hazelnut cream.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, soy and tree nuts (almond and hazelnut). Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts.

menuCategories.name: Tiramisu & Flans
menuCategories.note: Large desserts can be portioned for convenient service.

items.name: Classic Tiramisu
items.description: Two layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers and generous mascarpone cream with subtle vanilla-rum aroma and a chocolate finish.
items.texture: Light and silky with fully softened, never soggy ladyfingers and clean bakery-style slices.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Contains caffeine and alcohol. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Traditional Portuguese Flan
items.description: A classic ring flan with a glossy deep-amber caramel top, abundant caramel sauce, rich egg-and-milk flavor and subtle lemon-vanilla aroma.
items.texture: Smooth and silky, firm enough to unmold and slice without becoming dense or rubbery.
items.allergens: Contains milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles wheat, peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Chocoflan
items.description: Glossy caramel-topped Portuguese-style flan layered over moist dark chocolate cake for a balanced caramel-and-cocoa dessert.
items.texture: Silky creamy custard with clearly defined layers and a moist chocolate cake base.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Contains caffeine. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

menuCategories.name: Cakes & Cupcakes
menuCategories.note: Whole cakes are available for custom orders and can be pre-sliced.

items.name: Classic New York–Style Cheesecake
items.description: A rich vanilla cheesecake with balanced cream-cheese tang and a thin graham cracker crust.
items.texture: Dense-creamy and smooth, with clean slices after chilling and a creamy finish at serving temperature.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Classic 4-Layer Chocolate Cake
items.description: Four layers of dark, deeply chocolate cake with silky chocolate ganache buttercream and clean bakery-style decoration.
items.texture: Tall, moist and tender with smooth rich frosting and enough structure for clean slices.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Contains caffeine. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Carrot Cake with Vanilla-Almond Cream Cheese Frosting
items.description: A four-layer, carrot-forward cake warmed with cinnamon, ginger, cardamom and nutmeg, finished with tangy vanilla-almond cream cheese frosting. No nuts or raisins are added to the cake.
items.texture: Soft, very moist and tender without feeling oily or gummy.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Frosting includes almond extract. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

items.name: Classic Vanilla Cupcakes
items.description: Vanilla and vanilla bean create a full-flavored cupcake topped with a tall swirl of smooth vanilla buttercream.
items.texture: Soft, fine and moist with enough structure to support generous frosting.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.

menuCategories.name: Portuguese Pastries
menuCategories.note: Traditional pastries made in small batches.

items.name: Pastéis de Nata
items.description: Portuguese custard tarts with a crisp laminated shell, silky lemon-and-cinnamon-scented custard and characteristic dark caramelized spots.
items.texture: Shattering flaky pastry with a fully baked bottom and tender creamy custard.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk and egg. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts, tree nuts and soy.
